title: Importance of virtue ethics
competency: Identify and appreciate the importance of virtue ethics for individuals and society.

keywords.def: Ethics that judges right and wrong by what a person of good character (a "virtuous agent") would do.

en.text: Virtue ethics helps us tell right from wrong, become responsible contributing members of society, find the true purpose of life, build a positive attitude, and remove social evils such as discrimination, oppression and violence.
